notes.title: A full day!
notes.notes:
Hey you boar lovers!

It's been a great first day, we've been getting only positive reviews so thank you for that, it means a lot!

We've had 2 minor bugs to iron out so we pushed a new update, sorry about those and we hope the game will be "smooth sailing" for everybody else :)

Also, a question: some people have been asking questions about certain puzzles and achievements, should we publish some kind of walkthrough or just let you sweat it out? :)

We'll think about it :D
